name: Veeco

evidence.quote: Veeco Instruments Inc. is an American capital equipment supplier, headquartered in Plainview, New York that designs and builds processing systems used in semiconductor and compound semiconductor manufacturing, data storage and scientific markets for applications such as advanced packaging, photonics, power electronics and display technologies.
